public.AuthFrame.tsx: the auth page frame that access states and the connection response reuse
public.SessionActions.tsx: sign-out and switch-account actions that access, onboarding and settings reuse
public.SignInScreen.tsx: AFTER_SIGN_IN, the path access states and church documents send people to after sign-in
public.api.ts: the identity client API (loadPage, identityApi) that onboarding and settings call
public.parts.tsx: FormMessage and PasswordInput, form parts the account deletion screen reuses
public.server.ts: the answer and refused reply helpers that organization actions use
